novel_features.name: Saved-search cross-run diff
novel_features.description: Re-run a saved search and see exactly which listings are new and which dropped in price since last time.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible because every run's results are snapshotted in a local SQLite store and diffed across runs — Zameen has no API and no alerts.
novel_features.example: zameen-pp-cli watch dha-homes --city Islamabad --purpose buy --type Homes --area DHA_Defence --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to monitor a market over time instead of re-eyeballing search pages; it answers 'what changed since yesterday?' which no single fetch can.

novel_features.name: Area price research
novel_features.description: Median price, price-per-Marla, and inventory count for an area or society, computed from your synced listings.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates the local store by the location hierarchy with Marla-normalized math; no Zameen call returns area medians.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for area-level comps sheets and market rollups before a pitch or an offer.

novel_features.name: Below-market plot-file detector
novel_features.description: Ranks scanned listings by how far under the area's price-per-Marla they sit and flags below-market files.
novel_features.rationale: Joins each listing's computed price-per-Marla to the area median across the scanned set — a cross-entity comparison no page shows.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to surface underpriced plot files in Pakistan's plot-flipping market before another dealer grabs them.

novel_features.name: Days-on-market / aging inventory
novel_features.description: Lists the longest-standing inventory by days-on-market, derived from each listing's update timestamp.
novel_features.rationale: Computes age from unix timestamps in local SQLite — negotiation leverage the listing page never surfaces.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find sellers likely to negotiate — inventory that has sat on the market longest.

novel_features.name: Agency inventory leaderboard
novel_features.description: Ranks agencies by listing count and median asking price in an area, from your synced listings.
novel_features.rationale: Joins listings to their agency and rolls up locally — a supply-side view no single Zameen page exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to see who dominates supply in a society before choosing an agent or gauging market concentration.

narrative.headline: Search Zameen.com property listings from your terminal — real filters, an offline SQLite mirror, saved-search monitoring, and price-drop alerts no scraper offers.
narrative.value_prop: Zameen.com has no API and no alerts, so investors and agents refresh the same search pages by hand every day. This CLI searches with real filters (price, beds, area in Marla/Kanal, city/area), mirrors results into a local SQLite store, and diffs runs to surface new listings and price drops. Built-in `comps`, `deals`, and `aging` turn that store into area medians, below-market plot-file detection, and days-on-market leverage.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or API key needed. Zameen's public search is served as standard HTTP; the CLI reads listing data straight from the server-rendered search pages.

quickstart.comment: Confirm Zameen is reachable and the local store is ready — no auth required.
Search 3+ bed homes for sale in Islamabad under 3 crore.
Mirror the first 5 pages into the local store so offline search, comps, and diffing work.
Area price research: median price and price-per-Marla from your synced listings.

quickstart.command: zameen-pp-cli watch dha-homes --city Islamabad --purpose buy --type Homes --area DHA_Defence
quickstart.comment: Save this search and, on each re-run, see new listings and price drops since last time.

troubleshoots.symptom: find returns 0 results for a city name
troubleshoots.fix: Use a Zameen location slug with its numeric id (e.g. Islamabad-3, Lahore_DHA_Defence-9), or one of the known cities: Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan.

troubleshoots.symptom: comps / deals / watch say the store is empty
troubleshoots.fix: Run zameen-pp-cli pull --city <c> --purpose <buy|rent> --type <Homes|Plots|Commercial> --max-pages <n> first to populate the local mirror.

troubleshoots.symptom: scan seems capped and misses matches
troubleshoots.fix: Raise --max-scan-pages (find) or --max-pages (pull); Zameen filters are applied client-side, so more pages are scanned to find matches.

troubleshoots.symptom: HTTP 403 or challenge page from Zameen
troubleshoots.fix: The CLI already sends a browser User-Agent; if it persists you are likely rate-limited — wait and retry, or lower --max-pages.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to search and monitor Pakistan property listings from a terminal or an agent: parametric search across buy/rent, homes/plots/commercial; keeping a local SQLite mirror for offline comps, deals, and aging; and tracking a saved search over time for new listings and price drops. It is strongest for market research, deal-hunting (below-market plot files, aging inventory), and area comps.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to post, edit, or delete listings — it is read-only over Zameen's public search.
Do not use it to access a Zameen account, favorites, or saved alerts — it uses no login and touches no account data.
Do not use it for property portals outside Pakistan (Zillow, Rightmove, Bayut) — it is Zameen-specific.
Do not use it as a legal source of truth for prices or ownership — listing data is asking prices from public pages.

recipes.title: Search homes for sale under budget
recipes.command: zameen-pp-cli find --city Islamabad --purpose buy --type Homes --min-beds 3 --max-price 30000000 --sort price-asc
recipes.explanation: Three-plus-bed homes for sale in Islamabad under 3 crore, cheapest first.

recipes.title: Bulk-export a search to CSV
recipes.command: zameen-pp-cli find --city Lahore --purpose rent --type Homes --max-scan-pages 10 --csv > lahore-rentals.csv
recipes.explanation: Scan up to 10 pages of Lahore rentals and write a CSV for a spreadsheet.
